compiled_state.title: T3: GraphQL/REST thread-resolution helpers in merge-helpers.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Each poll iteration fetches unresolved thread node IDs via the reviewThreads GraphQL query
- DD2: REST reply via POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments/{id}/replies; resolveReviewThread mutation
- DD3: resolveReviewThread called only on threads confirmed unresolved (idempotent precheck)

## Description
Add four shell helpers to `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh` for the PR thread-resolution loop. Helpers wrap `gh api` invocations so they are testable via PATH-shadowed stubs. Each helper emits structured exit codes (0 = success, 1 = error) and prints structured stdout consumable by the loop in T4.

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh` (MODIFY)

## Helper Functions to Add

1. `_pr_fetch_unresolved_threads <pr_number>` — runs `gh api graphql -f query='...'` with the `reviewThreads(first:100)` query on the PR. Filters where `isResolved=false`. Prints one line per unresolved thread: `<thread_node_id>\t<file_path>\t<line_number>\t<latest_comment_id>\t<latest_comment_body_b64>`. Exit 0 if successful (even if empty); exit 1 on API/parse error.
2. `_pr_thread_is_unresolved <thread_node_id>` — idempotent precheck. Queries the single thread by node ID; prints `true` if `isResolved=false`, `false` otherwise. Exit 0 always (a missing thread is treated as `false`).
3. `_pr_post_thread_reply <pr_number> <comment_id> <reply_text>` — POSTs `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number}/comments/{comment_id}/replies` via `gh api -X POST -f body=<text>`. Exit 0 on 201 Created; exit 1 on any non-2xx response.
4. `_pr_resolve_thread <thread_node_id>` — calls the `resolveReviewThread` GraphQL mutation. MUST first call `_pr_thread_is_unresolved`; only invokes mutation when result is `true`. Exit 0 on success or already-resolved no-op; exit 1 on mutation error.

Owner/repo derivation: `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner --jq .nameWithOwner` (cached in module-level variable on first call).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh
- [ ] All four helpers defined
  Verify: for fn in _pr_fetch_unresolved_threads _pr_thread_is_unresolved _pr_post_thread_reply _pr_resolve_thread; do grep -qE "^${fn}\(\)" plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh || exit 1; done
- [ ] T1 RED tests now pass for the four helpers (specifically: test_review_threads_query_parses_unresolved_thread_ids, test_resolve_thread_calls_mutation_only_when_unresolved)
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh -k 'review_threads_query|resolve_thread_calls_mutation'
- [ ] Idempotent precheck enforced — `_pr_resolve_thread` does not call mutation when `_pr_thread_is_unresolved` returns `false`
  Verify: stub-call log assertion via T1 test_resolve_thread_calls_mutation_only_when_unresolved

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
